project_type: Python Strands AI agent with AWS CDK infrastructure
build_system: uv with hatchling backend, Dockerfile for deployment
test_framework: pytest with tests/ directory, mypy strict mode, ruff linter, black formatter
test_command: cd agent && uv run pytest -v --tb=short && uv run mypy src/ && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check .
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv sync to install deps. 2. Run pytest. 3. Run mypy src/. 4. Run ruff check. 5. Run black --check. 6. Optionally docker build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock - regenerated by uv lock/uv sync
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.14 available via pyenv. Docker available. python:3.14-slim image available on public.ecr.aws.
contribution_requirements: Use conventional commits. Run quality-check.sh before committing. Line length 100. Black formatting. Mypy strict mode.
key_patterns: Black infers target-version from requires-python when not explicitly set. Ruff also infers target-version from requires-python when not explicitly set in [tool.ruff]. Mypy needs explicit python_version setting. The .python-version file at repo root controls pyenv/uv python version.
directory_structure: Root has .python-version, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/workflows/. agent/ has pyproject.toml, Dockerfile, quality-check.sh, src/ (source), tests/ (tests), uv.lock. cdk/ has TypeScript CDK infra (not affected by this change).
